static_validation.scope: AST and bounded explicit artifact metadata reads only. Root independently reviews and executes the helper after publication and exact Hub replay.

archive_contract.local_mapping: Exact bytes and SHA-256 with local_path; every nonweight released artifact is copied. Release README is retained as published-README.md; archive README is generated from actual negative outcomes.
archive_contract.Hub_mapping: Exact bytes and SHA-256 with immutable /resolve/<revision>/ URL for all published files; only the six original trial states, two selected aliases and inputs/parent-checkpoint.json remain Hub-only.
all_nonweight_release_closure_retained: Standalone new and old numerical owners, source import closure, parser and tests
Saved validation XML and independent reviews
Full TRAIN, selection, five-cohort selected and parent panels
Losses, checkpoint roles, case-level decisions, summaries and durable barriers
Old source inputs/references and archived parent panels
Sampled guardian observations, exit and RSS scope receipts
Release builders, publisher, replay helper and correction history
postpublication_supplements: Exact local selected replay and replay helper/build/review
Actual result/resource review and trial artifact audit
Corrected release-preparation and passing publication preflight
Upload parent/proposal/commit, complete immutable readback and all-eight download receipts
Exact immutable Hub selected replay and passing independent publication review
Incoming progress/main integration, resource phase correction and preservation projection
Archiver source and this frozen build note
Any explicit --evidence paths, including later source-merge/report receipts
archive_contract.private_cross_agent_resource_bodies: Never copied. Public exact artifact pins and preservation projection remain retained. Both declared release files and supplementary files are checked against protected private full-ledger identities.

optional_cli.--artifacts-root: Defaults to the helper directory; controls required supplementary receipt lookup.
optional_cli.--local-replay: Defaults to selected-checkpoint-replay.json in the helper directory.
optional_cli.--hub-commit: Defaults to hub-upload-commit.json in the helper directory.
optional_cli.--hub-readback: Defaults to hub-readback-verification.json in the helper directory.
optional_cli.--hub-downloads: Defaults to hub-all-checkpoint-downloads.json in the helper directory.
optional_cli.--evidence: Repeat explicit ordinary existing file paths for later report/source-contribution/independent-review receipts. Destinations use evidence/additional/<basename>; duplicates are refused.
optional_cli.--receipt: Optional fresh external build receipt. It must be outside the archive and must not already exist.

byte_and_path_guards: All release paths are bounded ordinary relative paths; symlinks, traversal, wildcard/glob filenames and undeclared tree entries are refused.
Only directories derived from release manifest paths are listed; no recursive worktree traversal occurs.
Release bytes, original-to-release mapping coverage, Hub identities and local copies are checked exactly.
All nonweight bytes are checked before creating the fresh archive and again while copied; source drift is refused.
Exclusive fsynced writes avoid overwriting existing archive content.
Known credential filenames, binary weight suffixes, token/private-key patterns and embedded raw checkpoint containers are refused.
No promotion, semantic admission, native runtime qualification or latent-conditioning claim is permitted.

truthful_readme.outcome: Both actual cold update 0 selections; no selected fitted improvement or default replacement.
truthful_readme.authority: Engineered authored source occurrence proposals; all five admission masks zero, formal_output null.
truthful_readme.prior_native384_lineage: Retained separately; this trial does not rerun or promote those completed recipes.
truthful_readme.resource_claim: Sampled group RSS only; no absolute peak, continuous coverage or kernel hard-cap assertion.

limits: Prepared helper and AST inspection do not establish runtime archive completion or approval. Root must independently review and run it only after final publication and Hub replay receipts exist.
Narrow reconcile-agent receipt/path cross-check found no obvious schema mismatch; it is not a full independent archiver approval.
Known-pattern secret checks do not prove absence of every possible unknown secret; the declared release and supplements remain subject to independent review.
Historical absolute paths are provenance. Manifest mappings support checked path rebinding but do not claim a generic portable training runtime.
If a later copy or drift check fails, the helper leaves the newly owned partial archive for explicit inspection; it never deletes or rewrites existing workspace artifacts.
Later source merge/report receipts are retained only if supplied explicitly before archive creation. The helper does not stage or commit source, archive or reports.
